sn_aia_tool.description: Sends an automated email with the required document to the customer's registered email. Resolves the email address from: (1) explicit input, (2) customer_contact.email, (3) customer_account.email or primary_contact, (4) the loan case contact. Uses GlideEmailOutbound.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"recipient_email":{"type":"string","description":"Explicit email address. If omitted, resolved automatically from customer_sys_id, account_sys_id, or case_sys_id."},"recipient_name":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the email recipient."},"customer_sys_id":{"type":"string","description":"Contact sys_id from Retrieve_Customer_Profile — used to look up email if not provided."},"account_sys_id":{"type":"string","description":"Account sys_id from Retrieve_Customer_Profile — fallback email source."},"case_sys_id":{"type":"string","description":"Loan case sys_id from Query_Loan_Case — fallback email source via case contact."},"document_type":{"type":"string","description":"Document type label. Default: \"Level 1 Authorizer Signature Document\"."},"case_number":{"type":"string","description":"Loan case number for reference in the email subject and body."},"business_name":{"type":"string","description":"Business name to include in the email body."}},"required":[]}
sn_aia_tool.name: Send_Automated_Email
